title: Spell
description: A spell: a composition of one or more effects (drawn from the shared effect registry) tagged with a color magic school. The governing skill is <color>_magic.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

cost.description: Casting cost. Derived in-engine from the sum of effects; stored here as the authored baseline.

reagents.description: Ingredient refs (namespaced core:ingredient/<key>) used as reagents for this spell

custom.description: True for player-made (spellmaking) spells; false or omitted for authored content
